name: 语音输入
author: zRa1ny
description: 在 dsh Web 输入框的发送按钮一侧加一个麦克风按钮：点击开始录音，识别结果实时逐字写入待发送框，再点一次停止。基于浏览器 Web Speech API，纯客户端实现，不占用 Host、不注册模型工具。
descriptionEn: Adds a mic button beside the send button in the dsh Web composer: click to start recording and watch the transcript appear in the draft live, click again to stop. Pure client-side, built on the browser Web Speech API.
